title: Maximum Swap
summary: Given an integer, swap at most two digits to achieve the highest possible value.
statement: Given an integer, swap at most two digits to achieve the highest possible value. Return this highest value.
constraints: Swap at most one pair of decimal digits to maximize the integer.
hints: The earliest digit that can increase dominates every later improvement.
At that position, swap with the rightmost occurrence of the largest available digit.
Record each digit’s last index; scan left to right and digits 9 downward.
Rightmost placement leaves the displaced smaller digit as late as possible after maximizing the most significant change.
editorial: Rightmost placement leaves the displaced smaller digit as late as possible after maximizing the most significant change.

tests.explanation: Swap two and seven to produce 7236.
No swap improves a number whose digits already descend.
